name: @alanwalton/atlas-native-shell
description: iOS Capacitor shell (thin WKWebView over the live atlas.alanwalton.com site). Carries a background-location native seam (parent #15549 phase 1): the @capgo/background-geolocation + @capacitor/preferences plugins, and scripts/apply-ios-seam.sh (Info.plist location strings + UIBackgroundModes). Built on the macbook via Xcode.

scripts.ios:add: bash ../../akasha/code-system/ios-apps/shell-scripts/write-capacitor-config/write-capacitor-config.shell-script.shell.sh capacitor.config.json && cap add ios && bash scripts/apply-ios-seam.sh
scripts.ios:sync: bash ../../akasha/code-system/ios-apps/shell-scripts/write-capacitor-config/write-capacitor-config.shell-script.shell.sh capacitor.config.json && cap sync ios && bash scripts/apply-ios-seam.sh
